Alex/Priya — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- Goals we heard: reduce inference latency for triage workflows to <200ms p50, standardize on hosted inference for dev/test, and evaluate private deployment for PHI workloads.
- Primary success metric: 20–30% per-token cost reduction while keeping quality parity for current prompts.
- Key stakeholders to include on the tech deep-dive: Engineering (infra + backend), Security (compliance lead), and a product owner.

Next step: technical deep-dive / demo to validate integration surface and run a short perf profile on a representative prompt set. The team we’d bring: Rafael (solutions engineer) + me for product/architecture. 

Proposed 60-min windows (all in PT):
- Wed 29 Sep — 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Thu 30 Sep — 09:00–10:00

Two quick asks so we can lock the invite:
1) Which time works best? reply with 1st/2nd choice and timezone.
2) Do you prefer Google Meet or Zoom for the session? (we can send either — Meet preferred by your team today?)
3) Attendee list (names + roles) so we bring the right technical owners and pre-load any environment notes.

I attached a short summary of our discovery notes we referenced in the call. I’ll draft an invite once you confirm a slot and bridge preference.

Thanks — talk soon,

— Soojin Lee
